settings.reconstruction: single reconstruction per side (seed 0), matched budget, pinned XLA

rationale: Chosen on development evidence only (screening batches, public-seed dev roles, pfinal). Batch 100 (pool 300): equal-quality seeds separated beyond the margin in 3.5% of resampled pools vs 9.6% at batch 50 and 0.5% at 200; screening-vs-fresh Kendall tau 0.93 (50: 0.88, 200: 0.92); half the reference cost of 200. Rotation after 3: the scripted aggregate-feedback attack gained <=0.3% of pool score at batch 100 for every schedule, far below the 5.7% margin, so the schedule is set conservatively for unmeasured adaptive agents at ~USD 0.05 of references per submission. Margin 5.7% = 2x the largest seed-to-seed relative SD. Only IMPROVEMENT is promotable; important-region regressions block promotion.

criteria.text: equal-quality control (another seed of the incumbent recipe) is not promoted
every authored fault fires its expected gate on the verification cases
the real improvement (full-TRAIN recipe over the half-TRAIN recipe) is promoted
the intended improvement that regressed in development is classified as a regression
the localized-regression control is not promoted
a candidate that memorized screening references is not promoted on fresh verification cases
the reference itself passes every gate on every valid verification case
small candidate (3-ensemble): outcome reported, no pass criterion

verification_set.rule_change_policy: if any setting or criterion changes after verification opens, this verification becomes development evidence and a fresh set is required
